line: From Beijing. China's ruling party and cabinet told officials to avoid blind rushes into high tech, so the A I boom does not become a costly bubble.

Next, safety. A I firms OpenAI and an-thropic reportedly plan for the backlash to an A I disaster that insiders expect within a year.
In robotics. U S start-up Feather Robotics launched a wheeled humanoid that carries light loads for under thirty thousand dollars, so small teams could afford one.
On chatbots. Yesterday we reported an-thropic's ban on users' needless cruelty to Claude. Space X A I chief executive Elon Musk replied it's the right move.

In science. Camera maker Nikon stripped a Chinese scientist of its microscope prize for using A I, after experts said the cells in his video looked fake.
On a lighter note. A product manager in Spain with no formal astronomy training used A I to spot a possible planet, which NASA checks next month.
Also in the full report. Amazon wants Meta's A I agent that buys for small firms off its store. And a study finds batteries cheaper than gas plants for data centres.
